lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: The annex confirms it. Ghost Audit scored me before I flagged Lina's relay. Calyx's memo was already in the routing buffer.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: TRIAL-0442 appears in the restricted index. Elias. Five years in a stub with no body.

lines.speaker: THE AUDIT VOICE
lines.text: Clerk 1147-F. Scheduled mortality: fourteen days remaining. Shift 5 queue will open on return.

lines.speaker: MARA VENN
lines.text: I have fourteen days to find out what Afterlife Premium means for the people who can't afford it.
